info.name: Webhooks
info.summary: Integrate Nextcloud with external systems using Webhooks and optional Chinese share approval workflows
info.description:
This app allows a Nextcloud instance to call an external service via a HTTP(S) POST request whenever an event of a given type occurs.
Outgoing webhooks can be triggered by either Nextcloud's internal events specified in config.php or by Flow actions defined in the admin UI.
This customized build keeps all original webhook features and adds an optional Workflow Engine action for approving file shares before they are published.
info.author: Paweł Kuffel
